text: What kind of product instantly makes you want to contribute to it?

answers.text: “A product with thoughtful UX, clear user empathy, and strong visual consistency. I get excited when design genuinely improves someone’s experience.”
“A product with complex user flows and high quality standards. I enjoy finding edge cases and helping make the experience stable and reliable.”
“A system with interesting architecture challenges, scalability needs, or performance problems to solve behind the scenes.”
“A product that generates meaningful data and uses insights to improve decisions, personalization, or user behavior understanding.”
“A product with interactive interfaces, polished UI, and opportunities to create smooth, intuitive user experiences.”
